title: Grade 5 French — Wed, Jun 18
description: Le corps humain — Day 3 of 5: Chez le médecin (at the doctor's)
subject: french

questions.question: "Le médecin" means:
questions.explanation: Le médecin = the doctor. Le médecin examines patients and prescribes medicine.

questions.question: "Qu'est-ce qui ne va pas?" means:
options: What is wrong? / What's the matter?
questions.explanation: Qu'est-ce qui ne va pas? = What's wrong? What's the matter? A doctor asks this first.

questions.question: How do you say 'I am sick' in French?
questions.explanation: Je suis malade = I am sick. Malade (adj.) = sick / ill. Does not change for masc./fem. (same form).

questions.question: "J'ai de la fièvre" means:
questions.explanation: J'ai de la fièvre = I have a fever. La fièvre = the fever. De la = partitive article (some fever).

questions.question: "Je tousse" means:
questions.explanation: Je tousse = I cough. Tousser = to cough. La toux = the cough (noun).

questions.question: "J'éternue" means:
questions.explanation: J'éternue = I sneeze. Éternuer = to sneeze. 'À tes souhaits!' = 'Bless you!' in French.

questions.question: "Un médicament" means:
questions.explanation: Un médicament = a medicine / medication. Prendre un médicament = to take a medicine.

questions.question: "Une ordonnance" means:
questions.explanation: Une ordonnance = a prescription. The doctor writes an ordonnance for medicines.

questions.question: Complete the doctor's dialogue: 'Ouvrez la bouche, s'il vous plaît.' This means:
questions.explanation: Ouvrez la bouche = open your mouth. La bouche = the mouth. S'il vous plaît = please (formal).

questions.question: The doctor says: 'Vous devez vous reposer et boire beaucoup d'eau.' What is the advice?
options: Take medicine and go to hospital.
You must rest and drink lots of water.
You must exercise and eat well.
questions.explanation: Vous devez = you must; vous reposer = rest; boire = drink; beaucoup d'eau = lots of water.

questions.question: How do you say 'Since when have you been sick?' (depuis quand = since when)?
questions.explanation: Depuis quand êtes-vous malade? = Since when have you been sick? Depuis = since.

questions.question: Patient says: 'Je suis malade depuis deux jours.' This means:
options: I have been sick for two weeks.
I have been sick for two days.
I will be sick for two days.
I was sick two days ago.
questions.explanation: Depuis deux jours = for two days. Depuis + duration = how long something has been going on.

questions.question: "Il faut prendre ce médicament trois fois par jour" means:
options: Take this medicine once a day.
You must take this medicine three times a day.
This medicine is taken three days.
Take medicine in the morning only.
questions.explanation: Il faut = it is necessary / you must. Trois fois par jour = three times a day.

questions.question: How do you say 'I have an appointment with the doctor'? (un rendez-vous = an appointment)
options: J'ai un rendez-vous avec le médecin.
questions.explanation: J'ai un rendez-vous avec le médecin = I have an appointment with the doctor.

questions.question: Role-play: 'Bonjour docteur. Je ne me sens pas bien. J'ai mal à la gorge et j'ai de la fièvre.' The patient is saying:
options: Hello doctor. I have a headache and a cough.
Hello doctor. I don't feel well. I have a sore throat and a fever.
Hello doctor. I have a stomach ache and I am sneezing.
Hello doctor. I have a sore back and I am tired.
questions.explanation: Je ne me sens pas bien = I don't feel well. Mal à la gorge = sore throat. De la fièvre = fever.
